(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 2.0 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3) SENSOR VOTING & CROSS-CHANNEL DRIFT MONITORING                                   *)
(* Evaluates median for healthy triplets, isolates single-point sensor drift, and degrades smoothly to 1oo2.             *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* --- 2.1 Train Kinematic Velocity 2oo3 Voting --- *)
bVel_A_OK := (rTrainVelocity_A >= -5.0) AND (rTrainVelocity_A <= 650.0);
bVel_B_OK := (rTrainVelocity_B >= -5.0) AND (rTrainVelocity_B <= 650.0);
bVel_C_OK := (rTrainVelocity_C >= -5.0) AND (rTrainVelocity_C <= 650.0);

IF bVel_A_OK AND bVel_B_OK AND bVel_C_OK THEN
    IF (rTrainVelocity_A >= rTrainVelocity_B AND rTrainVelocity_A <= rTrainVelocity_C) OR
       (rTrainVelocity_A >= rTrainVelocity_C AND rTrainVelocity_A <= rTrainVelocity_B) THEN
        rVotedTrainVelocity := rTrainVelocity_A;
    ELSIF (rTrainVelocity_B >= rTrainVelocity_A AND rTrainVelocity_B <= rTrainVelocity_C) OR
          (rTrainVelocity_B >= rTrainVelocity_C AND rTrainVelocity_B <= rTrainVelocity_A) THEN
        rVotedTrainVelocity := rTrainVelocity_B;
    ELSE
        rVotedTrainVelocity := rTrainVelocity_C;
    END_IF;
    bVel_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;
    IF (ABS(rTrainVelocity_A - rTrainVelocity_B) > c_rVelocityTol) OR
       (ABS(rTrainVelocity_B - rTrainVelocity_C) > c_rVelocityTol) OR
       (ABS(rTrainVelocity_C - rTrainVelocity_A) > c_rVelocityTol) THEN
        dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0001; (* Velocity Transducer Drift Advisory *)
    END_IF;
ELSIF bVel_A_OK AND bVel_B_OK THEN
    rVotedTrainVelocity := (rTrainVelocity_A + rTrainVelocity_B) * 0.5;
    bVel_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0002; (* Velocity Channel C Offline *)
ELSIF bVel_B_OK AND bVel_C_OK THEN
    rVotedTrainVelocity := (rTrainVelocity_B + rTrainVelocity_C) * 0.5;
    bVel_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0004; (* Velocity Channel A Offline *)
ELSIF bVel_A_OK AND bVel_C_OK THEN
    rVotedTrainVelocity := (rTrainVelocity_A + rTrainVelocity_C) * 0.5;
    bVel_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0008; (* Velocity Channel B Offline *)
ELSE
    bSystemTrip := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0002; (* Complete Loss of 2oo3 Train Velocity Telemetry *)
END_IF;

(* --- 2.2 Dynamic Air-Gap Clearance 2oo3 Voting --- *)
bGap_A_OK := (rAirGapDistance_A >= 4.0) AND (rAirGapDistance_A <= 30.0);
bGap_B_OK := (rAirGapDistance_B >= 4.0) AND (rAirGapDistance_B <= 30.0);
bGap_C_OK := (rAirGapDistance_C >= 4.0) AND (rAirGapDistance_C <= 30.0);

IF bGap_A_OK AND bGap_B_OK AND bGap_C_OK THEN
    IF (rAirGapDistance_A >= rAirGapDistance_B AND rAirGapDistance_A <= rAirGapDistance_C) OR
       (rAirGapDistance_A >= rAirGapDistance_C AND rAirGapDistance_A <= rAirGapDistance_B) THEN
        rVotedAirGapDistance := rAirGapDistance_A;
    ELSIF (rAirGapDistance_B >= rAirGapDistance_A AND rAirGapDistance_B <= rAirGapDistance_C) OR
          (rAirGapDistance_B >= rAirGapDistance_C AND rAirGapDistance_B <= rAirGapDistance_A) THEN
        rVotedAirGapDistance := rAirGapDistance_B;
    ELSE
        rVotedAirGapDistance := rAirGapDistance_C;
    END_IF;
    bGap_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;
    IF (ABS(rAirGapDistance_A - rAirGapDistance_B) > c_rAirGapTol) OR
       (ABS(rAirGapDistance_B - rAirGapDistance_C) > c_rAirGapTol) OR
       (ABS(rAirGapDistance_C - rAirGapDistance_A) > c_rAirGapTol) THEN
        dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0010; (* Air-Gap Sensor Discrepancy Warning *)
    END_IF;
ELSIF bGap_A_OK AND bGap_B_OK THEN
    rVotedAirGapDistance := (rAirGapDistance_A + rAirGapDistance_B) * 0.5;
    bGap_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0020;
ELSIF bGap_B_OK AND bGap_C_OK THEN
    rVotedAirGapDistance := (rAirGapDistance_B + rAirGapDistance_C) * 0.5;
    bGap_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0040;
ELSIF bGap_A_OK AND bGap_C_OK THEN
    rVotedAirGapDistance := (rAirGapDistance_A + rAirGapDistance_C) * 0.5;
    bGap_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0080;
ELSE
    bSystemTrip := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0004; (* Complete Loss of Air-Gap Telemetry *)
END_IF;
rCalculatedAirGap_mm := rVotedAirGapDistance;

(* Air-Gap Safety Window Interlock *)
IF (rVotedAirGapDistance < c_rAirGapMinLimit) OR (rVotedAirGapDistance > c_rAirGapMaxLimit) THEN
    bAirGapViolationAlarm := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0008; (* Air-gap excursion out of 7.5 - 19.5 mm limit *)
ELSE
    bAirGapViolationAlarm := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* --- 2.3 Stator Air-Gap Magnetic Flux Density 2oo3 Voting --- *)
bFlx_A_OK := (rStatorFluxDensity_A >= 0.05) AND (rStatorFluxDensity_A <= 2.20);
bFlx_B_OK := (rStatorFluxDensity_B >= 0.05) AND (rStatorFluxDensity_B <= 2.20);
bFlx_C_OK := (rStatorFluxDensity_C >= 0.05) AND (rStatorFluxDensity_C <= 2.20);

IF bFlx_A_OK AND bFlx_B_OK AND bFlx_C_OK THEN
    IF (rStatorFluxDensity_A >= rStatorFluxDensity_B AND rStatorFluxDensity_A <= rStatorFluxDensity_C) OR
       (rStatorFluxDensity_A >= rStatorFluxDensity_C AND rStatorFluxDensity_A <= rStatorFluxDensity_B) THEN
        rVotedStatorFlux := rStatorFluxDensity_A;
    ELSIF (rStatorFluxDensity_B >= rStatorFluxDensity_A AND rStatorFluxDensity_B <= rStatorFluxDensity_C) OR
          (rStatorFluxDensity_B >= rStatorFluxDensity_C AND rStatorFluxDensity_B <= rStatorFluxDensity_A) THEN
        rVotedStatorFlux := rStatorFluxDensity_B;
    ELSE
        rVotedStatorFlux := rStatorFluxDensity_C;
    END_IF;
    bFlx_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;
ELSIF bFlx_A_OK AND bFlx_B_OK THEN
    rVotedStatorFlux := (rStatorFluxDensity_A + rStatorFluxDensity_B) * 0.5;
    bFlx_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0100;
ELSIF bFlx_B_OK AND bFlx_C_OK THEN
    rVotedStatorFlux := (rStatorFluxDensity_B + rStatorFluxDensity_C) * 0.5;
    bFlx_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0200;
ELSIF bFlx_A_OK AND bFlx_C_OK THEN
    rVotedStatorFlux := (rStatorFluxDensity_A + rStatorFluxDensity_C) * 0.5;
    bFlx_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0400;
ELSE
    bSystemTrip := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0010; (* Stator Flux TMR Sensor Failure *)
END_IF;
rEstimatedAirGapFlux_T := rVotedStatorFlux;

(* --- 2.4 Intermediate DC Bus Voltage 2oo3 Voting --- *)
bBus_A_OK := (rDCBusVoltageFeedback_A >= 500.0) AND (rDCBusVoltageFeedback_A <= 2000.0);
bBus_B_OK := (rDCBusVoltageFeedback_B >= 500.0) AND (rDCBusVoltageFeedback_B <= 2000.0);
bBus_C_OK := (rDCBusVoltageFeedback_C >= 500.0) AND (rDCBusVoltageFeedback_C <= 2000.0);

IF bBus_A_OK AND bBus_B_OK AND bBus_C_OK THEN
    IF (rDCBusVoltageFeedback_A >= rDCBusVoltageFeedback_B AND rDCBusVoltageFeedback_A <= rDCBusVoltageFeedback_C) OR
       (rDCBusVoltageFeedback_A >= rDCBusVoltageFeedback_C AND rDCBusVoltageFeedback_A <= rDCBusVoltageFeedback_B) THEN
        rVotedDCBusVoltage := rDCBusVoltageFeedback_A;
    ELSIF (rDCBusVoltageFeedback_B >= rDCBusVoltageFeedback_A AND rDCBusVoltageFeedback_B <= rDCBusVoltageFeedback_C) OR
          (rDCBusVoltageFeedback_B >= rDCBusVoltageFeedback_C AND rDCBusVoltageFeedback_B <= rDCBusVoltageFeedback_A) THEN
        rVotedDCBusVoltage := rDCBusVoltageFeedback_B;
    ELSE
        rVotedDCBusVoltage := rDCBusVoltageFeedback_C;
    END_IF;
    bBus_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;
ELSIF bBus_A_OK AND bBus_B_OK THEN
    rVotedDCBusVoltage := (rDCBusVoltageFeedback_A + rDCBusVoltageFeedback_B) * 0.5;
    bBus_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_1000;
ELSIF bBus_B_OK AND bBus_C_OK THEN
    rVotedDCBusVoltage := (rDCBusVoltageFeedback_B + rDCBusVoltageFeedback_C) * 0.5;
    bBus_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_2000;
ELSIF bBus_A_OK AND bBus_C_OK THEN
    rVotedDCBusVoltage := (rDCBusVoltageFeedback_A + rDCBusVoltageFeedback_C) * 0.5;
    bBus_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_4000;
ELSE
    bSystemTrip := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0020; (* DC Bus Transducer TMR Failure *)
END_IF;
rStabilizedDCBusVoltage := rVotedDCBusVoltage;

(* Intermediate Bus Voltage Window Interlock *)
IF rVotedDCBusVoltage > c_rDCBusMaxTripVoltage THEN
    bSystemTrip := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0040; (* Overvoltage Crowbar Interlock Trip *)
ELSIF (rVotedDCBusVoltage < c_rDCBusMinTripVoltage) AND (iState >= 30) THEN
    bSystemTrip := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0080; (* Undervoltage Bus Collapse Trip *)
END_IF;

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 3.0 SECOND-ORDER GENERALIZED INTEGRATOR (SOGI) PLL FOR GRID INVERSION & FLUX TRACKING                                  *)
(* Generates quadrature signals (alpha, beta) and performs Park transformation to achieve vector lock.                  *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Compute characteristic tooth-ripple slot frequency from velocity *)
IF rVotedTrainVelocity > 10.0 THEN
    rHarmonicRippleFrequency := (rVotedTrainVelocity / 3.6) / c_rSlotPitch;
ELSE
    rHarmonicRippleFrequency := c_rNominalGridFreq;
END_IF;

(* Resonant angular frequency for SOGI *)
rSOGI_CenterFreq := c_rTwoPi * rHarmonicRippleFrequency;
IF rSOGI_CenterFreq < 100.0 THEN
    rSOGI_CenterFreq := 100.0;
ELSIF rSOGI_CenterFreq > 16000.0 THEN
    rSOGI_CenterFreq := 16000.0;
END_IF;

(* Select input signal: Inverter mode uses grid reference, Harvesting mode uses phase U voltage *)
IF iState >= 20 THEN
    rSOGI_v_in := rGeneratorPhaseVoltage_U;
ELSE
    rSOGI_v_in := 325.0 * SIN(rPLL_Theta);
END_IF;

(* Discrete Tustin SOGI Orthogonal Integrator *)
(* Error input: e = v_in - v_alpha *)
rTmpA := rSOGI_v_in - rSOGI_x1;
(* Integrator 1: d(v_alpha)/dt = k * omega_0 * e - omega_0 * q_alpha *)
rSOGI_x1 := rSOGI_x1 + c_rScanTimeSeconds * (rSOGI_Gain_k * rSOGI_CenterFreq * rTmpA - rSOGI_CenterFreq * rSOGI_x2);
(* Integrator 2: d(q_alpha)/dt = omega_0 * v_alpha *)
rSOGI_x2 := rSOGI_x2 + c_rScanTimeSeconds * (rSOGI_CenterFreq * rSOGI_x1);

rSOGI_v_alpha := rSOGI_x1;
rSOGI_v_beta  := rSOGI_x2;

(* Synchronous Park Transformation: alpha-beta to d-q *)
rThetaSin := SIN(rPLL_Theta);
rThetaCos := COS(rPLL_Theta);

rPLL_vd :=  rSOGI_v_alpha * rThetaCos + rSOGI_v_beta * rThetaSin;
rPLL_vq := -rSOGI_v_alpha * rThetaSin + rSOGI_v_beta * rThetaCos;

(* Loop Filter PI on v_q *)
rPLL_PI_Integrator := rPLL_PI_Integrator + c_rScanTimeSeconds * rPLL_Ki * rPLL_vq;
IF rPLL_PI_Integrator > 18000.0 THEN
    rPLL_PI_Integrator := 18000.0;
ELSIF rPLL_PI_Integrator < 50.0 THEN
    rPLL_PI_Integrator := 50.0;
END_IF;

rPLL_Omega := rSOGI_CenterFreq + (rPLL_Kp * rPLL_vq) + rPLL_PI_Integrator;

(* Phase Angle Integrator with [0, 2*PI] wrapping *)
rPLL_Theta := rPLL_Theta + c_rScanTimeSeconds * rPLL_Omega;
IF rPLL_Theta >= c_rTwoPi THEN
    rPLL_Theta := rPLL_Theta - c_rTwoPi;
ELSIF rPLL_Theta < 0.0 THEN
    rPLL_Theta := rPLL_Theta + c_rTwoPi;
END_IF;
rInverterPhaseAngle_Rad := rPLL_Theta;

(* Phase Lock Detection *)
IF ABS(rPLL_vq) < 18.0 THEN
    rPLL_LockTimerAccum := rPLL_LockTimerAccum + c_rScanTimeSeconds;
    IF rPLL_LockTimerAccum >= 0.015 THEN
        bPLLLocked := TRUE;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rPLL_LockTimerAccum := 0.0;
    bPLLLocked := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 4.0 HIGH-SPEED MAGLEV LINEAR INDUCTION GENERATOR HARVESTING & ACTIVE RECTIFICATION                                    *)
(* Decoupled dq current vector control and space vector duty modulation.                                                *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Stationary Clarke Transformation: 3-phase currents to alpha-beta *)
rI_alpha := (2.0 / 3.0) * (rGeneratorPhaseCurrent_U - 0.5 * rGeneratorPhaseCurrent_V - 0.5 * rGeneratorPhaseCurrent_W);
rI_beta  := (2.0 / 3.0) * (0.866025 * rGeneratorPhaseCurrent_V - 0.866025 * rGeneratorPhaseCurrent_W);

(* Synchronous Park Transformation: alpha-beta to d-q *)
rI_d :=  rI_alpha * rThetaCos + rI_beta * rThetaSin;
rI_q := -rI_alpha * rThetaSin + rI_beta * rThetaCos;

(* Estimate Harvested Total Inductive Power [kW] *)
rHarvestedPower_Total := (1.5 * (rPLL_vd * rI_d + rPLL_vq * rI_q)) / 1000.0;
IF rHarvestedPower_Total < 0.0 THEN
    rHarvestedPower_Total := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Active Rectifier Decoupled Current Regulators *)
(* d-Axis: Controls reactive flux / dynamic repulsive damping *)
rTmpA := rI_d_Ref - rI_d;
rPI_d_Integrator := rPI_d_Integrator + c_rScanTimeSeconds * rCurrent_Ki * rTmpA;
IF rPI_d_Integrator > 800.0 THEN
    rPI_d_Integrator := 800.0;
ELSIF rPI_d_Integrator < -800.0 THEN
    rPI_d_Integrator := -800.0;
END_IF;
rV_d_Decoupled := (rCurrent_Kp * rTmpA) + rPI_d_Integrator - (rPLL_Omega * c_rInductance_Lgen * rI_q);

(* q-Axis: Controls active electrical power harvesting *)
rTmpB := rI_q_Ref - rI_q;
rPI_q_Integrator := rPI_q_Integrator + c_rScanTimeSeconds * rCurrent_Ki * rTmpB;
IF rPI_q_Integrator > 800.0 THEN
    rPI_q_Integrator := 800.0;
ELSIF rPI_q_Integrator < -800.0 THEN
    rPI_q_Integrator := -800.0;
END_IF;
rV_q_Decoupled := (rCurrent_Kp * rTmpB) + rPI_q_Integrator + (rPLL_Omega * c_rInductance_Lgen * rI_d) + rPLL_vd;

(* Inverse Park Transformation: dq to alpha-beta *)
rV_alpha_Cmd := rV_d_Decoupled * rThetaCos - rV_q_Decoupled * rThetaSin;
rV_beta_Cmd  := rV_d_Decoupled * rThetaSin + rV_q_Decoupled * rThetaCos;

(* Space Vector PWM Duty Cycle Synthesis *)
IF rVotedDCBusVoltage > 200.0 THEN
    rTmpA := (rV_alpha_Cmd / rVotedDCBusVoltage) * 0.866025;
    rTmpB := (rV_beta_Cmd  / rVotedDCBusVoltage) * 0.500000;
    
    rActiveRectifierDuty_U := 0.5 + (rV_alpha_Cmd / rVotedDCBusVoltage);
    rActiveRectifierDuty_V := 0.5 - rTmpB + rTmpA;
    rActiveRectifierDuty_W := 0.5 - rTmpB - rTmpA;
ELSE
    rActiveRectifierDuty_U := 0.0;
    rActiveRectifierDuty_V := 0.0;
    rActiveRectifierDuty_W := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Clamp Duties to Permissible [0.05, 0.95] Range for Bootstrap Refresh *)
IF rActiveRectifierDuty_U < 0.05 THEN rActiveRectifierDuty_U := 0.05; ELSIF rActiveRectifierDuty_U > 0.95 THEN rActiveRectifierDuty_U := 0.95; END_IF;
IF rActiveRectifierDuty_V < 0.05 THEN rActiveRectifierDuty_V := 0.05; ELSIF rActiveRectifierDuty_V > 0.95 THEN rActiveRectifierDuty_V := 0.95; END_IF;
IF rActiveRectifierDuty_W < 0.05 THEN rActiveRectifierDuty_W := 0.05; ELSIF rActiveRectifierDuty_W > 0.95 THEN rActiveRectifierDuty_W := 0.95; END_IF;

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 5.0 DYNAMIC AIR-GAP (10-15 mm) EDDY CURRENT REPULSIVE DAMPING VECTOR CONTROLLER                                       *)
(* Extracts vertical velocity dz/dt, applies digital biquad notch filter, and injects repulsive damping into i_d_Ref.   *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
rRawAirGapVelocity := (rVotedAirGapDistance - rPrevAirGap) / c_rScanTimeSeconds;
rPrevAirGap := rVotedAirGapDistance;
rDynamicAirGapVelocity := rRawAirGapVelocity;

(* Digital Biquad Notch Filter (Suppresses 3.2 Hz bogie mechanical resonance) *)
rFilteredAirGapVelocity := (rNotch_b0 * rRawAirGapVelocity) + (rNotch_b1 * rNotch_x1) + (rNotch_b2 * rNotch_x2)
                           - (rNotch_a1 * rNotch_y1) - (rNotch_a2 * rNotch_y2);

(* Update Delay Line Registers *)
rNotch_x2 := rNotch_x1;
rNotch_x1 := rRawAirGapVelocity;
rNotch_y2 := rNotch_y1;
rNotch_y1 := rFilteredAirGapVelocity;

(* Synthesize Dynamic Repulsive Damping Force Command [N] *)
rEddyCurrentDampingTorque_d := - (rDampingGain_Kd * rFilteredAirGapVelocity) - (rStiffnessGain_Kp * (rVotedAirGapDistance - c_rNominalAirGap));
rEddyCurrentDampingTorque_q := 0.0; (* Tangential drag compensated via LSM propulsion *)

(* Inject into direct-axis current reference *)
rI_d_Ref := rEddyCurrentDampingTorque_d * 0.125;
IF rI_d_Ref > rMaxDampingCurrent_Limit THEN
    rI_d_Ref := rMaxDampingCurrent_Limit;
ELSIF rI_d_Ref < -rMaxDampingCurrent_Limit THEN
    rI_d_Ref := -rMaxDampingCurrent_Limit;
END_IF;

IF ABS(rEddyCurrentDampingTorque_d) > 10.0 THEN
    bActiveDampingActive := TRUE;
ELSE
    bActiveDampingActive := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 6.0 SUPERCAPACITOR-BATTERY HYBRID BUS STABILIZATION & FREQUENCY POWER SPLITTING                                       *)
(* Dual-storage management: Supercap handles high-frequency surges; Battery handles low-frequency continuous power.      *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* DC Bus Voltage Outer-Loop PI Regulator *)
rBusVoltageError := c_rDCBusNominalVoltage - rVotedDCBusVoltage;
rBusVoltagePI_Integrator := rBusVoltagePI_Integrator + c_rScanTimeSeconds * rBus_Ki * rBusVoltageError;
IF rBusVoltagePI_Integrator > 350.0 THEN
    rBusVoltagePI_Integrator := 350.0;
ELSIF rBusVoltagePI_Integrator < -350.0 THEN
    rBusVoltagePI_Integrator := -350.0;
END_IF;

rTotalPowerDeficit := rAuxiliaryLoadDemandPower - rHarvestedPower_Total - rBrakingPowerRegenSurge
                      + (rBus_Kp * rBusVoltageError) + rBusVoltagePI_Integrator;

(* 2nd-Order Butterworth Low-Pass Filter on Power Deficit *)
rBatteryPowerDemand := (rLPF_b0 * rTotalPowerDeficit) + (rLPF_b1 * rLPF_P_batt_x1) + (rLPF_b2 * rLPF_P_batt_x2)
                       - (rLPF_a1 * rLPF_P_batt_y1) - (rLPF_a2 * rLPF_P_batt_y2);

rLPF_P_batt_x2 := rLPF_P_batt_x1;
rLPF_P_batt_x1 := rTotalPowerDeficit;
rLPF_P_batt_y2 := rLPF_P_batt_y1;
rLPF_P_batt_y1 := rBatteryPowerDemand;

(* High-Frequency Residual Dispatched to Supercapacitor *)
rSupercapPowerDemand := rTotalPowerDeficit - rBatteryPowerDemand;

(* Supercapacitor SOC: (V_sc^2 - V_min^2) / (V_max^2 - V_min^2) * 100% *)
rTmpA := (rSupercapVoltage * rSupercapVoltage) - (c_rSupercapMinVoltage * c_rSupercapMinVoltage);
rTmpB := (c_rSupercapMaxVoltage * c_rSupercapMaxVoltage) - (c_rSupercapMinVoltage * c_rSupercapMinVoltage);
IF rTmpB > 0.0 THEN
    rSupercapSOC := (rTmpA / rTmpB) * 100.0;
ELSE
    rSupercapSOC := 50.0;
END_IF;
IF rSupercapSOC < 0.0 THEN rSupercapSOC := 0.0; ELSIF rSupercapSOC > 100.0 THEN rSupercapSOC := 100.0; END_IF;

IF rSupercapVoltage >= (c_rSupercapMaxVoltage - 25.0) THEN
    bSupercapOvervoltageAlarm := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0001_0000;
ELSE
    bSupercapOvervoltageAlarm := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Battery SOC Integration via Coulomb Counting *)
rBatterySOC := rBatterySOC - (rBatteryCurrent * (c_rScanTimeSeconds / 3600.0) / c_rBatteryCapacityAh) * 100.0;
IF rBatterySOC < 0.0 THEN rBatterySOC := 0.0; ELSIF rBatterySOC > 100.0 THEN rBatterySOC := 100.0; END_IF;

IF rBatterySOC < 20.0 THEN
    bBatteryDeepDischargeAlarm := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0002_0000;
ELSE
    bBatteryDeepDischargeAlarm := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Duty Cycle Synthesis for Bidirectional Buck-Boost Converters *)
(* Supercapacitor Duty: d_sc = V_sc / (V_sc + V_dc) in buck-boost or V_sc / V_dc in boost *)
IF rVotedDCBusVoltage > 100.0 AND rSupercapVoltage > 50.0 THEN
    rSupercapBuckBoostDuty := rSupercapVoltage / rVotedDCBusVoltage;
ELSE
    rSupercapBuckBoostDuty := 0.50;
END_IF;

(* Battery Duty *)
IF rVotedDCBusVoltage > 100.0 AND rBatteryVoltage > 50.0 THEN
    rBatteryBuckBoostDuty := rBatteryVoltage / rVotedDCBusVoltage;
ELSE
    rBatteryBuckBoostDuty := 0.48;
END_IF;

IF rSupercapBuckBoostDuty < 0.05 THEN rSupercapBuckBoostDuty := 0.05; ELSIF rSupercapBuckBoostDuty > 0.95 THEN rSupercapBuckBoostDuty := 0.95; END_IF;
IF rBatteryBuckBoostDuty < 0.05 THEN rBatteryBuckBoostDuty := 0.05; ELSIF rBatteryBuckBoostDuty > 0.95 THEN rBatteryBuckBoostDuty := 0.95; END_IF;

(* Check Bus Voltage Stabilization Flag (+/- 1.5% of 1500 V = +/- 22.5 V) *)
IF ABS(rVotedDCBusVoltage - c_rDCBusNominalVoltage) <= 22.5 THEN
    bHybridBusStabilized := TRUE;
ELSE
    bHybridBusStabilized := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 7.0 COMPLETE 8-STATE DISCRETE MODEL & MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) QUADRATIC OPTIMIZATION                            *)
(* Solves unconstrained gradient step, projects onto box constraints across 10 iterations per millisecond.                *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Assemble State Deviation Vector x *)
x1_VdcDev   := rVotedDCBusVoltage - c_rDCBusNominalVoltage;
x2_IscDev   := rSupercapCurrent;
x3_IbattDev := rBatteryCurrent;
x4_ZgapDev  := rVotedAirGapDistance - c_rNominalAirGap;
x5_VgapDev  := rFilteredAirGapVelocity;
x6_IdDev    := rI_d - rI_d_Ref;
x7_IqDev    := rI_q - rI_q_Ref;
x8_ThetaDev := rPLL_vq;

(* State Prediction: x_next = Ad * x + Bd * u *)
x1_Next := (Ad_11*x1_VdcDev) + (Ad_12*x2_IscDev) + (Ad_13*x3_IbattDev) + (Ad_14*x4_ZgapDev) + (Ad_15*x5_VgapDev) + (Ad_16*x6_IdDev) + (Ad_17*x7_IqDev) + (Ad_18*x8_ThetaDev)
         + (Bd_11*u1_Opt_DutySC) + (Bd_12*u2_Opt_DutyBatt) + (Bd_13*u3_Opt_VdCmd) + (Bd_14*u4_Opt_VqCmd);

x2_Next := (Ad_21*x1_VdcDev) + (Ad_22*x2_IscDev) + (Ad_23*x3_IbattDev) + (Ad_24*x4_ZgapDev) + (Ad_25*x5_VgapDev) + (Ad_26*x6_IdDev) + (Ad_27*x7_IqDev) + (Ad_28*x8_ThetaDev)
         + (Bd_21*u1_Opt_DutySC) + (Bd_22*u2_Opt_DutyBatt) + (Bd_23*u3_Opt_VdCmd) + (Bd_24*u4_Opt_VqCmd);

x3_Next := (Ad_31*x1_VdcDev) + (Ad_32*x2_IscDev) + (Ad_33*x3_IbattDev) + (Ad_34*x4_ZgapDev) + (Ad_35*x5_VgapDev) + (Ad_36*x6_IdDev) + (Ad_37*x7_IqDev) + (Ad_38*x8_ThetaDev)
